subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: After the pre-replace health-recovery race is fixed, must this provider-backed WeChat hot-reload change include redacted live A+B QR-login evidence before merge, or may focused gateway lifecycle proof be accepted?
rationale: Only a gateway owner can set the acceptable evidence threshold for a provider-backed reload path that the contributor cannot exercise from the current environment.

options.title: Require live WeChat proof
options.body: Require a redacted A+B QR-login run showing account A remains online after account B triggers the reload handoff.

options.title: Waive provider proof
options.body: Explicitly accept the focused gateway lifecycle regressions and normal checks as sufficient for this narrowly scoped fix.

recommendation.title: Require live WeChat proof
recommendation.body: Require a redacted A+B QR-login run showing account A remains online after account B triggers the reload handoff.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR timeline identifies joshavant as a gateway-review routing candidate; no stronger ownership evidence was available in the supplied history.
